capabilities: Compose Markdown and Word manuscripts into journal page proofs edited beside the preview
Switch between journal templates and customize logos, colors, fonts and running heads
Run APA-oriented checks and optional Crossref lookups on citation details
Export composed PDFs and editable Affinity (AF) and IDML files
Import and export self-contained template ZIPs
disambiguation: Not a text or grammar editor for academic writing; it composes finished manuscripts into journal page proofs and print files.
extras: The community directory listing is under review, so the author points users to the GitHub release ZIP; AF export requires desktop Obsidian (1.8.9+) and macOS hardware was not tested for 1.0.0. Changes made in Affinity do not sync back to Markdown.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin for researchers and editors who want a carefully composed paper without rebuilding every page by hand.
problem: Obsidian can store and render Markdown but has no way to compose a manuscript into a designed, paginated journal page or hand off an editable print file.

requires.name: Affinity (desktop app, only for editing the AF export)

summary: Manuscript composer that turns Markdown or Word manuscripts into paginated journal layouts, exporting PDF plus editable Affinity and IDML files.
